subject.title: [Showcase] AgentPay — Production x402 Facilitator for OpenClaw Agents (works with Grok integration)

question: Should OpenClaw curate or document AgentPay as an endorsed autonomous-payment integration, and if so, should that support remain an external ClawHub package rather than core onboarding or environment configuration?
rationale: The report proposes a new external financial-service relationship and user-facing recommendation, so code inspection alone cannot determine the acceptable trust, approval, and curation boundary.

options.title: External package first
options.body: Ask for a ClawHub skill or plugin with scoped configuration, clear spending approvals, install docs, and redacted real-world proof before considering a docs listing.

options.title: Do not curate
options.body: Decline an official recommendation while leaving the provider free to publish and maintain an independent OpenClaw-compatible package.

options.title: Sponsor a security review
options.body: Assign an owner to define the required wallet, credential, approval, and recovery contract before any endorsed integration is built.

recommendation.title: External package first
recommendation.body: Ask for a ClawHub skill or plugin with scoped configuration, clear spending approvals, install docs, and redacted real-world proof before considering a docs listing.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked RFC provides the closest existing OpenClaw payment-design context, though ownership is low-confidence because that proposal was closed and technically different.
